# C03 — Genesis and one-use bootstrap (r1)

## Package record

Delta **C03**, preparation **r1**, integration owner **P08-C/P06**. Classification: **PROPOSED new persistent genesis/bootstrap contract and supervisor/kernel publication semantics**; exact bytes and production backend unresolved. [Spec 26 v1.1 §1](../../../docs/specs/26-workload-placement-scaling-contract.md), [C03 inventory](../abi-deltas.md#3-required-cluster-publicpersistent-delta-families), [P08-C](../phase-08-distributed.md) control this design. CP1/CP2 pending; 38 locks unchanged. Documentation only, no approval/activation.

**SOURCE-OBSERVED** describes cited source, **PROPOSED** describes the selected contract; **RUNTIME-OBSERVED: none for C03**. [Census](../consumer-census-source.json) is lexical only; issuer/storage/keyed-genesis production closure is not observed.

## Old contract and source anchors

- [Supervisor main](../../../cells/services/supervisor/src/main.rs), lines 1–11, 40–91: init registers/restarts the supervisor; supervisor processes hotswap/snapshot requests with name-based caller selection. This is not authorized application-budget bootstrap or a durable genesis issuer.
- [Supervisor hotswap](../../../cells/services/supervisor/src/hotswap.rs), lines 95–169: pauses, snapshots, freezes, spawns replacement, restores/Ready/commits, kills old task and clears stash. SnapshotTimeout currently proceeds with empty stash (113–116); it cannot prove durable control-ledger recovery.
- [Local quota reservation](../../../kernel/src/memory/cell_quota.rs), lines 183–205: local unpublished Cell quota ownership. Not one persistent application ledger or one-use cross-node bootstrap.
- [ServerEpochSource](../../../cells/services/net-broker/src/server_epoch.rs), lines 12–29: volatile boot-local export sequence. It is not a durable Authority enforcement fence.
- [ClusterSection](../../../libs/api/src/services/cluster.rs), lines 75–105: routing-only 16-byte section. It provides no ledger/bootstrap record.

## Selected proposal and representation boundary

PROPOSED: the authorized application budget issuer is the **only genesis creator**. Before publishing any Authority/controller/router, it durably precommits exactly one logical application ledger identity, immutable maximum, assigned fixed Authority home/principal/fence and separate controller home/epoch, with exact charged control envelopes, measured artifacts, destinations and stable creation keys. Supervisor consumes a scoped one-use bootstrap grant; it never creates a new ledger or maximum. The control roles start independently of the managed workload.

The genesis semantic record must distinguish immutable ledger identity/maxima and per-role bootstrap key/vector/artifact/destination from mutable consumed/claimed/publication-result state. A bootstrap grant binds the exact issuer, application/ledger, Authority home/fence, role, destination, artifact/tier, key and complete vector. The Authority's initial own bootstrap consumption is rooted in the issuer precommit, not an impossible self-issued live reservation; **after** its own keyed publication/reconciliation it adopts that existing charge and enables ordinary C04 claims for controller/router. This is a genesis-only issuer path, not a reusable offline allowance for workload replicas.

PROPOSED representation: separate versioned durable genesis and consumption/result records. Exact encoding, key/fence widths, bootstrap issuer API, proof carrier, transaction/flush primitive and retention bounds remain blocker-bound. No backend, signer or reserved opcode is invented.

## State transitions, ordering and recovery

| Transition | Required ordering / refusal boundary |
|---|---|
| `NoGenesis -> Precommitted` | Issuer atomically establishes unique ledger identity plus maximum/control reservations and durability barrier **before** emitting any bootstrap grant. Failure/uncertain flush does not permit spawn or a second initialization. Query/reconcile the same issuer key. |
| `Precommitted -> BootstrapConsumed` | Assigned supervisor/destination checks authentic issuer, exact key/home/artifact/vector/role and independent local admission; serializes one-use consumption with keyed publication. A copied grant cannot publish at another node/key. |
| `BootstrapConsumed -> Published/PublicationUnknown` | Kernel keyed publication outcome refers to the same control incarnation. Lost reply retains precommitted charge; no new control key or uncharged replacement. Exact consume/publication cross-owner protocol requires I2. |
| `AuthorityPublished -> GenesisReconciling -> LedgerActive` | Authority recovers durable maximum/balance/fence and reconciles all bootstrap records against keyed kernel publication before ledger mutations/controller admission. Already-consumed same-key lookup returns original result, not another spend. |
| `LedgerActive -> Recovering -> LedgerActive` | Restart preserves logical ledger/maxima and all reserved/live/unknown charges; durably advances/reestablishes qualified monotonic enforcement fence before fresh grants. Controller remains mutation-closed until Authority recovery and its own intent reconciliation. |
| `Unknown -> Closed` | Only authoritative absence/Gone plus durable key closure and local quiescence, then Authority/issuer-owned release. Timeout, empty lookup, task restart or partition is insufficient. |

Home relocation, automatic promotion, second empty genesis and reinitialization on corrupt/unavailable storage are prohibited. Controller/router bootstrap is charged ordinary management work after genesis adoption; no managed-replica request is needed to start the authority that would admit it.

## Errors, outputs, lifetime and side effects

PROPOSED semantic outcomes: invalid/wrong-home grant, consumed key with changed binding, unauthorized issuer, local capacity rejection, incomplete genesis, stale fence and unavailable persistence refuse before new publication. A proven same-key completed result is returned idempotently without reminting. Uncertain precommit/consume/publication returns reconciliation-required with the stable original key and charge, not success/absence. Exact public errors/status/output bytes and short-buffer rules await CP1; rejected paths must publish no usable grant, and ambiguous output must never authorize another key.

Genesis/maxima/fence survive all control process restarts. Consumption/result/closed-key records cannot expire while delayed publication or replay remains possible. Artifact rollback cannot roll back ledger state or free unknown control Cells. Close mutation, recover the same ledger and retain charges; don't restart with an empty application allowance. Local quota deregistration is not global bootstrap release evidence.

## Units, bounds and charge owners

Control vectors use C02 counts/bytes/CPU entitlement; one bounded ledger, finite Authority/controller/router count, bootstrap keys, pending results and closure/history slots. All control envelopes debit the application before first spawn; storage and recovery metadata are part of those envelopes. Issuer owns precommit; supervisor consumes; destination owns keyed local publication; Authority owns recovered enforcement balance. P01/P03/P08 provide measured control and durable high-water/retention bounds; no numerical profile selected.

Proposed `tests/integration/exact_delta_c03.rs` belongs to P08-E/P10. Authorized issuer/durable storage implementation/path remains an input, not a fake service.

## Required negative scenarios

Crash before/after issuer precommit flush, grant emission, one-use consumption, kernel publish and reply; duplicate copied grant/wrong destination/artifact/key; supervisor reboot; Authority restart with previously live and unknown controls; unavailable/corrupt/rolled-back ledger; controller starts before genesis adoption; control shares omitted; second bootstrap maximum; stale home/fence and timeout promotion. Oracle: at most the original keyed control publication, unchanged logical allowance, all unknown charged, no controller mutation before recovery.

1. **C03-I1 Authorized genesis producer** — P08-C/P01 supplies actual application budget issuer/principal/API, maximum and control-role/artifact/key assignment. Blocks authentic precommit/grant and concrete producer migration; existing supervisor cannot mint it.
2. **C03-I2 Durable genesis/consume/publication protocol** — P08-C/P06/P02/storage owner supplies selected backend, unique-init transaction, flush/error/rollback capability and exact linearization across issuer, supervisor and kernel. Blocks irreversible ordering and crash-safe one-use bootstrap; no durable backend is asserted here.
3. **C03-I3 Exact record/proof and fence profile** — P01/P08-A/C/P06 fixes canonical genesis/grant/result/closure bytes, authenticator, key/fence exhaustion, retention/replay and qualified monotonic fence evidence. Blocks exact persistent ABI and recoverability claims; boot-local ServerEpoch is insufficient.
4. **C03-I4 Control footprint and caller closure** — P01/P03/P08 measures actual Authority/controller/router/bootstrap/history envelopes and inventories all image/init/supervisor/keyed kernel/storage callers plus target-feature artifacts. Blocks finite control admission and complete-cutover claim.

C01 identities/homes, C02 vectors, C04 ordinary reserve/claim/closure, P06 keyed intents/state authority, D07/D11 lifecycle/manifest and original protected Build/AC-012. P08-C genesis adoption precedes controller/routers and B live routing.

**CP1 pending:** exact I1–I4 evidence, old/new records/caller/error/output table, candidate revision/digest and explicit decision. **CP2 pending:** actual durable backend plus qualified issuer/kernel bootstrap/restart/crash traces and measured charged envelopes on approved artifacts. # C05 — Mutable allocation, pending shrink and drain (r2)

## Package record

Delta **C05**; preparation **r2**; integration owner **P03/P08-C/P06**. Classification: **PROPOSED public/persistent resize/drain records and semantic amendment of resource/lifecycle admission**. Not implemented or exact byte schema. [Spec 26 v1.1 §§3–6](../../../docs/specs/26-workload-placement-scaling-contract.md), [C05 inventory](../abi-deltas.md#3-required-cluster-publicpersistent-delta-families), [P08-C/D](../phase-08-distributed.md) govern. CP1/CP2 pending, 38 locks unchanged, no activation/approval. Supersedes r1 with whole-vector safe mixed resize and publication fencing before Gone.

**SOURCE-OBSERVED** means cited source, **PROPOSED** selected contract; **RUNTIME-OBSERVED: none for C05**. [Profile ledger](../profile-budgets.md#accounting-invariants-and-resize-split) explicitly separates P03 local primitives from real P08-C growth witness. [Census](../consumer-census-source.json) is not reference closure.

## Old contract and source anchors

- [cell_quota.rs](../../../kernel/src/memory/cell_quota.rs), lines 26–43: cold-boot default quota setter, not immutable incarnation max/current-vector resize. Local register/deregister does not prove global positive-delta reservation or physical retirement.
- [scheduler.rs](../../../kernel/src/task/scheduler.rs), line 22 and thread admission; [tcb.rs](../../../kernel/src/task/tcb.rs), lines 414–424: existing local thread/watchdog/CPU samples are not mutable aggregate entitlement enforcement.
- [Supervisor hotswap](../../../cells/services/supervisor/src/hotswap.rs), lines 95–177: local pause/freeze/restore/Ready/commit/kill/rollback. SnapshotTimeout proceeds empty at 113–116; neither that fallback nor kill proves retained operation/state quiescence required for cluster shrink.
- [Bound local operation state](../../../kernel/src/task/async_ipc.rs) and [broker request/reply state](../../../cells/services/net-broker/src/local_queue/state/ops.rs) retain work beyond a route/controller decision; removing a route cannot free those resources.

## Selected proposal and representation boundary

PROPOSED: freeze immutable incarnation authority/resource maxima `M` at creation, maintain independently mutable admitted allocation `A <= M`, and measure current use/obligations `U` through authoritative local owners. Only authorized budget issuer changes application ceiling; Authority enforces it; controller only orchestrates. Application pending target and effective charged ceiling are distinct, so below-use shrink never pretends charges already disappeared.

For growth target `A'`, reserve `delta_plus[d] = max(A'[d] - A[d], 0)` at Authority and destination **before use/publication**, even for mixed grow/shrink vectors; no optimistic netting against unreleased negative components. Above-M growth refuses that incarnation and needs a separately authorized budgeted replacement. Resize keys bind exact incarnation, old/new allocation revision/vector, Authority/controller fence and operation identity; repeat reconciles the same resize.

PROPOSED versioned current-allocation/resize-intent/pending-ceiling/drain-cutoff/retirement records, not quota-default mutation or rights-max rewrite. Exact representation and backend atomicity are blocker-bound below.

## State transitions and ordering

| Transition | Required behavior |
|---|---|
| `Stable(A) -> GrowthReserved(delta_plus)` | Validate C01 issuer/policy, immutable M and current allocation revision; Authority durably reserves positive delta; destination live-claims/reserves local matching enforcement before exposing additional use. Failure before acceptance changes nothing. |
| `GrowthReserved -> Applied(A')/ShrinkPending(A')/GrowthUnknown` | Select whole-vector application: expose **no** positive component and install no negative component until authoritative use/retained obligations fit every target dimension under the admission lock. A mixed grow/shrink target below use enters ShrinkPending with all positive reservations retained but unusable. Once safe, destination atomically installs the entire vector/revision and publishes result. Unknown installation/result keeps positive delta charged and blocks conflicting resize; reconcile same key/revision. |
| `Stable(A) -> ShrinkPending(A')` for pure shrink where any U exceeds target | Retain current enforcement and granted rights/work. Suspend creates/growth in affected scope; record target, drain policy and bounded reconciliation. Mixed vectors reach the same pending state only after the positive reservations above. Do not kill work or revoke granted authority to force fit. |
| `ShrinkPending -> SafeLimit(A')` | Authoritative use/retained obligations fit each new dimension; atomically install the entire safe vector using any retained positive reservations, then release only proven-unused negative delta through Authority with acknowledged local fence. No partial growth exposure or negative release credited before safe enforcement. |
| `ApplicationCeiling(B) -> PendingTarget(B')` below charge | Authorized issuer records target; close new creates/growth and drain budgeted replicas. Keep effective charged ceiling until charge fits B'; then atomically adopt B'. Controller cannot enlarge/replace issuer maximum. |
| `Ready -> AdmissionClosed -> Draining` | Remove future routing, independently close destination new-admission and acknowledge cutoff. Old routers arriving later must refuse before effect; admitted operations/grants/results retain original rights and deadlines. |
| `Draining -> KeyPublicationFenced -> Quiescent -> Gone -> DurablyClosedKey -> Released` | Establish C04's creation-key claim/publication fence before trusting absence/Gone; workload request-admission cutoff alone is insufficient. The key fence must survive restart and delayed create messages. Reconcile operations/outcomes/buffer/resource owners, establish required state watermark/single-writer fence, and retire the exact incarnation. Authority releases only after authoritative Gone plus durable enforced key closure and quiescence; partition/unknown stays pending/charged. |

Resource class/concurrency resize removes member from homogeneous C10 scaling domain pending approved reclassification; never reinterpret target T or useful capacity silently. Replacement simultaneously charges old draining/unknown and new reservation until safe old release. No timeout authorizes another writer or uncharged replacement.

## Errors, outputs, lifetime and side effects

PROPOSED refusal classes: unauthorized issuer/current-revision mismatch, malformed vector/overflow, immutable-max violation, local/global exhaustion, stale fence and authority unavailable. Below-use shrink is explicit **pending**, not a successful reduction or an error suppressed as success. Unknown grow/drain returns reconciliation-required tied to same key/incarnation; expose no free budget or larger current-limit handle before confirmed enforcement. Exact ABI codes and copy-fault/short-output behavior remain CP1 inputs.

Resize intents, cutoff acknowledgements, old allocation revisions, admitted rights, terminal outcomes and writer-watermark proofs remain retained until authoritative settlement. Rollback after durable growth/drain is recovery, not binary state reversal. Closing destination admission does not discard pre-cutoff work; controller/Authority timeout, missing telemetry and transport loss cannot classify Gone or release uncertainty.

## Units, bounds and charge owners

C02 dimensional units apply. Positive delta and replacement consume Authority allowance; local enforcement/storage and pending/drain/unknown slots are measured finite charges. P03 owns exact use/max/current limit and cross-CPU admission/retirement; P05 resource issuer owns pins/DMA/lineage; P04 operation outcomes; P06 state fence/key closure; P08-C Authority owns debit/release. [Profile ledger](../profile-budgets.md#exact-parameter-prerequisites-and-non-promotion-rules) supplies required cost/CPU evidence, not finite selected policy. Drain durations bound waiting/reconciliation work, never become a release lease.
